title: Gold rising or falling in every major currency at once: persistence

rule.state: all six L-day returns of gold in each currency > 0 (+1) or < 0 (-1)
rule.entry: next gold open after the state turns
rule.exit: next gold open after the state leaves the side, or the close of candle 60
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: gold up (down) over 20 days in all six currencies: buy (sell), both sides (primary)
gold down over 20 days in all six currencies: sell (sells only)
gold up (down) over 60 days in all six currencies: buy (sell), both sides

context.what: context only: the same mechanics, state from gold in USD alone
